# AI Referral Share

`ai-referral-share` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · SEO, GEO & AEO
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/ai-referral-share/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** How much of our traffic and key events come from AI assistants such as ChatGPT, and do those visits really convert differently from the rest?

**Inputs:** A GA4 Traffic acquisition export by session source / medium (sessions, key events, and optionally revenue and engaged sessions), as CSV text or rows; optionally site totals and extra assistants to count

**Output:** Each AI assistant's sessions and key events with their share of the site, the rate against the rest of the site with an exact interval and a verdict (higher, lower, about the same, or not enough data), revenue and engagement where given, sources worth a second look, and how each assistant was recognised

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill ai-referral-share`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/ai-referral-share/resources/ai-referral-share.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/ai-referral-share/resources/ai-referral-share.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It counts only what GA4 attributed to an assistant. Visits from apps that pass no referrer, or links copied out of an answer, usually arrive as direct traffic and cannot be recovered here.
- Clicks from Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode are reported as Google search, so they cannot be separated from organic search.
- Assistants are recognised by web addresses their makers publish; a new assistant or a new address needs adding with extra.
- Without Session key event rate, the comparison counts key events, which can repeat within a session, so the interval is somewhat too narrow. Small assistants rarely get a verdict: the engine says when it can't tell.

**Review before acting:** The analytics owner confirms the export is session source / medium for one date range, unfiltered (or enters site totals), and that the key events counted are the ones that matter to the business.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/ai-referral-share](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/ai-referral-share)
